001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.cb;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.StarSystemAPI;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.FleetTypes;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithBarEvent;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.FleetQuality;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.FleetSize;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.OfficerNum;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.OfficerQuality;
013
014public class CBPather extends BaseCustomBountyCreator {
015
016        public static float PROB_IN_SYSTEM_WITH_BASE = 0.5f;
017        
018        @Override
019        public float getFrequency(HubMissionWithBarEvent mission, int difficulty) {
020                if (Factions.LUDDIC_PATH.equals(mission.getPerson().getFaction().getId())) return 0f;
021                return super.getFrequency(mission, difficulty) * CBStats.PATHER_FREQ;
022        }
023        
024        public String getBountyNamePostfix(HubMissionWithBarEvent mission, CustomBountyData data) {
025                return " - Pather";
026        }
027        
028        @Override
029        public CustomBountyData createBounty(MarketAPI createdAt, HubMissionWithBarEvent mission, int difficulty, Object bountyStage) {
030                CustomBountyData data = new CustomBountyData();
031                data.difficulty = difficulty;
032                
033//              if (difficulty >= 4) {
034//                      mission.requireSystemTags(ReqMode.ANY, Tags.THEME_RUINS, Tags.THEME_MISC, Tags.THEME_REMNANT_SECONDARY,
035//                                                                        Tags.THEME_DERELICT, Tags.THEME_REMNANT_DESTROYED);
036//              } else {
037//                      mission.requireSystemTags(ReqMode.ANY, Tags.THEME_RUINS, Tags.THEME_MISC,
038//                                                                        Tags.THEME_DERELICT);
039//              }
040                mission.requireSystemInterestingAndNotUnsafeOrCore();
041                mission.requireSystemNotHasPulsar();
042                if (difficulty >= 4 && mission.rollProbability(PROB_IN_SYSTEM_WITH_BASE)) {
043                        mission.preferSystemHasBase(Factions.LUDDIC_PATH);
044                }
045                if (difficulty <= 3) mission.preferSystemInInnerSector();
046                
047                StarSystemAPI system = mission.pickSystem();
048                data.system = system;
049        
050                FleetSize size = FleetSize.MEDIUM;
051                FleetQuality quality = FleetQuality.DEFAULT;
052                String type = FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM;
053                OfficerQuality oQuality = OfficerQuality.DEFAULT;
054                OfficerNum oNum = OfficerNum.DEFAULT;
055                
056                String factionId = Factions.LUDDIC_PATH;
057                
058                if (difficulty <= 0) {
059                        size = FleetSize.TINY;
060                        quality = FleetQuality.VERY_LOW;
061                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.LOWER;
062                        oNum = OfficerNum.FC_ONLY;
063                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_SMALL;
064                } else if (difficulty == 1) {
065                        size = FleetSize.VERY_SMALL;
066                        quality = FleetQuality.VERY_LOW;
067                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.LOWER;
068                        oNum = OfficerNum.FC_ONLY;
069                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_SMALL;
070                } else if (difficulty == 2) {
071                        size = FleetSize.SMALL;
072                        quality = FleetQuality.DEFAULT;
073                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.LOWER;
074                        oNum = OfficerNum.FEWER;
075                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_SMALL;
076                } else if (difficulty == 3) {
077                        size = FleetSize.SMALL;
078                        quality = FleetQuality.DEFAULT;
079                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.DEFAULT;
080                        oNum = OfficerNum.DEFAULT;
081                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM;
082                } else if (difficulty == 4 || difficulty == 5) {
083                        size = FleetSize.MEDIUM;
084                        quality = FleetQuality.DEFAULT;
085                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.DEFAULT;
086                        oNum = OfficerNum.DEFAULT;
087                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM;
088                } else if (difficulty == 6) {
089                        size = FleetSize.LARGE;
090                        quality = FleetQuality.DEFAULT;
091                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.DEFAULT;
092                        oNum = OfficerNum.DEFAULT;
093                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE;
094                } else if (difficulty == 7) {
095                        size = FleetSize.LARGE;
096                        quality = FleetQuality.HIGHER;
097                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.DEFAULT;
098                        oNum = OfficerNum.MORE;
099                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE;
100                } else if (difficulty == 8) {
101                        size = FleetSize.VERY_LARGE;
102                        quality = FleetQuality.HIGHER;
103                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.DEFAULT;
104                        oNum = OfficerNum.MORE;
105                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE;
106                } else if (difficulty == 9) {
107                        size = FleetSize.HUGE;
108                        quality = FleetQuality.HIGHER;
109                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.HIGHER;
110                        oNum = OfficerNum.MORE;
111                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE;
112                } else {// if (difficulty == 10) {
113                        size = FleetSize.MAXIMUM;
114                        quality = FleetQuality.HIGHER;
115                        oQuality = OfficerQuality.HIGHER;
116                        //oNum = OfficerNum.ALL_SHIPS;
117                        oNum = OfficerNum.MORE;
118                        type = FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE;
119                }
120                
121                beginFleet(mission, data);
122                mission.triggerCreateFleet(size, quality, factionId, type, data.system);
123                mission.triggerSetFleetOfficers(oNum, oQuality);
124                mission.triggerFleetPatherNoDefaultTithe();
125                mission.triggerAutoAdjustFleetSize(size, size.next());
126                mission.triggerSetStandardAggroPirateFlags();
127                mission.triggerPickLocationAtInSystemJumpPoint(data.system);
128                mission.triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation(null, null);
129                //mission.triggerOrderFleetPatrol(data.system);
130                mission.triggerOrderFleetPatrol(data.system, true, Tags.JUMP_POINT, Tags.SALVAGEABLE, Tags.PLANET, Tags.STATION);
131                data.fleet = createFleet(mission, data);
132                if (data.fleet == null) return null;
133                
134                setRepChangesBasedOnDifficulty(data, difficulty);
135                data.baseReward = CBStats.getBaseBounty(difficulty, CBStats.PATHER_MULT, mission);
136                
137                return data;
138        }
139        
140}
